## Description

R22: At phase close, the parent removes each task worktree `<repo>/.worktrees/<phase-slug>--<task-slug>` for that phase.
R23: At phase close, the parent deletes each `task/<phase-slug>/<task-slug>` branch that is contained in the phase branch.

## Approach

Edit only `skills/execute-phase/references/phase-end.md`. Do not edit `skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md` or any file under `tests/`.

In the Landing merge and close section, after the phase branch is merged, remove each `<repo>/.worktrees/<phase-slug>--<task-slug>` worktree for that phase and delete each `task/<phase-slug>/<task-slug>` branch that is contained in the phase branch. Keep the phase-close commit on `<repo>/.worktrees/<phase-slug>` with `git add -A -- . ':!.artifacts'`, then merge `phase/<phase-slug>` into `main` from the primary checkout.
